prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided blue cylindrical display capsule sprite. Create its replacement for a game museum showcase: transform the saturated blue metal into elegant clear colorless crystal glass with restrained silver/champagne metal edging, neutral white museum lighting, delicate realistic white reflections and transparent glass walls. It must feel like a high-end glass vitrine protecting an artwork, NOT a blue sci-fi machine. Keep EXACT camera angle, dimensions, position, silhouette, pedestal outline, empty interior, top ring, side supports and base contact from reference; keep full sprite and existing canvas padding. Remove strong blue/cyan saturation and neon glow. Base may be polished neutral clear crystal with subtle opaque silver structure so it is readable. Empty interior and background must have genuine alpha transparency; glass highlights are translucent, never a solid gray/white panel, no fake checkerboard, no room, no object inside, no text. Image reference has transparent pixels which must remain transparent. Produce one finished isolated PNG.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: this champagne/silver glass display capsule. Keep the exact capsule, materials, every dimension, position and silhouette unchanged. Replace ALL checkerboard pixels everywhere (outside AND inside the glass cylinder) with perfectly uniform saturated magenta RGB 255,0,255 flat chroma-key. No checkerboard whatsoever. No gradients or texture in magenta. Maintain metal and crystal facets unchanged with NO magenta reflections on solid metal. The cylinder must be empty: clear background with only thin white glass glints at its edges. No color wash over its empty center. This is an intermediate sprite for automatic background removal. Same canvas dimensions, same padding. No ground or shadow outside silhouette.
